result.topic_en: Notes on the Riemann P-function defined by an Euler-type integral, showing how permuting the four branch points a, b, c, d (through the cross-ratio x) changes the exponents λ, μ, ν, with an expression of P in terms of the hypergeometric series F and Π-functions.

items.english: One therefore always obtains an integral of the differential equation if one arbitrarily interchanges the quantities a,b,c,d and α,β,γ,δ correspondingly, and thus twenty-four expressions.
